_readme: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for which employers this system knows about. Everything else derives from it: the job scanner iterates it, auto_submit_config.json keys match its `id`s, the interview scan builds its Gmail search from `name` + `aliases`, and SOP overlays are named `<id>-<platform>.md`. To target a different industry or a different set of companies, edit this file — you should not have to touch any prompt or script.
_adding_a_company: Add an entry with a unique lowercase `id`, a display `name`, any `aliases` recruiters actually use in email, and an `adapter`. Park one you haven't reverse-engineered yet with `enabled: false` + `adapter: "unknown"` — the scanner skips it, but the interview scan still recognises its name in your inbox. Supported adapters: `workday`, `eightfold`, `sitecore_discover`.

config.note: 改用 Eightfold（appliedmaterials.com 實際導向的官方站）取代 Workday External site — 2026-08-11 實測 Workday 那個端點少了整個台南/Display 事業群的職缺（100 筆裡少 35 筆），Eightfold 才是完整資料源。

config.auth_token: <see docs/SETUP.md — grab it from the careers site's own JS bundle>
config.note: 2026-08-12 靠瀏覽器抓封包找到真正端點：Sitecore Discover API。auth_token 是網站前端 JS bundle 內建的公開 search-only key（每個訪客都一樣，不是登入 session），不是密鑰外洩——但公開 repo 裡不放實際字串，免得被 secret scanner 誤判。取得方式見 docs/SETUP.md。全職缺 JD 已內含在 list response 裡（j.description），不用像 Workday/Eightfold 那樣另外呼叫 detail API。
